E1.where: main: pp. 1-2; title, article label, and study description
E1.excerpt: In this paper we compare various levels of DFT theory, including GGA (PBE), Hubbard U corrected PBE (PBE+U), and hybrid functionals (B3PW91 and PBE0)

E3.excerpt: As a first step in understanding the mechanism for OER we carried out detailed Density Functional Theory (DFT) studies of the electronic structure of IrO2.

note: Electronic-structure and magnetism study; no OER intermediates or PCET steps are calculated.
